content.short: Pass is a community-governed and curated NFT Marketplace embracing Creators, Collectors, and Culture.
content.description: Pass brings NFT trading together on a single, intuitive platform designed for seamless discovery, easy connections, and smooth transactions. Users access a Personal Social Feed that helps track market trends and verify assets, contributing to fraud prevention. With a direct buying option and a community-driven ethos, Pass serves both newcomers to NFTs and experienced collectors seeking a streamlined, transparent trading experience across supported networks.
